note: FNS 843.1 is entirely a QC review procedure, not caseworker policy. It describes how a QC reviewer should handle error determination when two separately certified households should have been one — including consolidating authorized benefits, completing Comparison I calculations, applying error thresholds, and reporting on Form FNS-380-1. None of these are caseworker actions. The underlying policy question (who must be in the same SNAP household) IS covered in the OLG under 'Household Composition - SNAP' (spouses, children under 22, people who purchase and prepare food together) and 'Check Household Composition' (recertification interview procedures for verifying who lives in the home). The OLG appropriately covers the caseworker-facing policy; the QC error calculation methodology in 843.1 has no caseworker equivalent.
